verdict.rationale: An online IP-office service like DPMA could plausibly publish llms.txt or agent-oriented documentation, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only human-facing portals and filing guidance, with no llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. The only probe is a robots.txt on the register host that disallows general crawling, which says nothing positive about agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
